steps: Attach the X and A axes to the same logical machine
Ensure the axes are detached from their current logical machine before attaching
Check the Joint logical machine parameter for both axes
Check the program for correct axis attachment commands
Ensure no other program is conflicting with the axis attachment
Detach the axis from its current logical machine
Check the axis is not assigned to another logical machine
Reinitialise the logical machine configuration
Attach the axis to the desired logical machine
Check the part program search hierarchy configuration
Verify the part program 'm101.pp' exists in the search hierarchy paths
Ensure the M-code M101 is configured to use mode 4
Verify the part program 'm101.pp' is not corrupted or missing
Add at least three control points between splineon and splineoff commands.
Check the splineon and splineoff blocks for correct placement of control points.
Verify the spline type and parameters are correctly specified in the splineon block.
Edit the program to ensure only one class 1 preparatory word is used per block.
Check the G-code documentation to identify which words belong to class 1.
Verify the block syntax to ensure no multiple class 1 preparatory words are present.
Set the Joint logical device parameter for each joint to a unique logical device address.
Check the logical device addresses are unique across all joints.
Restart the system to apply changes.
Disable the OPC UA server by setting `opcua.enable` to `false`.
Check the license includes the OPC UA server option.
Purchase the OPC UA server option if required.
Verify the license is correctly applied.
Restart the EtherCAT system
Reinitialise the EtherCAT bus
Check the drive's reported error register

Check the EtherCAT master configuration for state consistency
Verify the device's safety settings are not conflicting with operational state
Restart the Ethercat bus

Verify the drive's communication status
Restart the EtherCAT master application
Check the EtherCAT master log file for detailed error information
Check the drive's reported error register for additional fault details
